headword: {遺伝情報|いでんじょうほう}

definitions.explanation: The biological instructions encoded in DNA that determine the characteristics of a living organism. Used in biology, medicine, and discussions about heredity and genetics.

examples.english: In recent years, technology for analyzing individual genetic information to predict disease risk has advanced.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{遺伝|いでん}→遺伝：10137_iden⟧ (heredity, genetics) and ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧ (information). A fundamental term in biology and medicine. With advances in genetic testing and personalized medicine, this term appears frequently in news and health discussions. Japan enacted the ⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧{遺伝情報|いでんじょうほう}⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧⟦ガイドライン→ガイドライン：10834_gaidorain⟧ to regulate the handling of personal genetic data.
